import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
r = nm.query("SELECT end_day, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day >= 326 GROUP BY end_day ORDER BY end_day")
print("cancels/day:")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['end_day'], row['n'])

# weekly cash flow from ledger
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, SUM(amount) net FROM ledger WHERE day >= {day-7} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
print("\nledger net/day:")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['day'], round(row['net']))
    tot += row['net']
print("7d net:", round(tot))

# revenue split last 7d
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) s FROM ledger WHERE day >= {day-6} GROUP BY category ORDER BY s")
print("\ncategories last 7d:")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['category'], round(row['s']))
